mapper.update: update t_eastmoney_node set `date` = SUBSTRING_index(SUBSTRING_index(infoRaw, ',', -11), ',', 1) , `open` = SUBSTRING_index(SUBSTRING_index(infoRaw, ',', -10), ',', 1) , `last` = SUBSTRING_index(SUBSTRING_index(infoRaw, ',', -9), ',', 1) , `high` = SUBSTRING_index(SUBSTRING_index(infoRaw, ',', -8), ',', 1) , `low` = SUBSTRING_index(SUBSTRING_index(infoRaw, ',', -7), ',', 1) , `volume` = SUBSTRING_index(SUBSTRING_index(infoRaw, ',', -6), ',', 1) , `amount` = SUBSTRING_index(SUBSTRING_index(infoRaw, ',', -5), ',', 1) , -- SUBSTRING_index(SUBSTRING_index(infoRaw, ',', -4), ',', 1), -- SUBSTRING_index(SUBSTRING_index(infoRaw, ',', -3), ',', 1), -- SUBSTRING_index(SUBSTRING_index(infoRaw, ',', -2), ',', 1), `exchangeRaw` = SUBSTRING_index(SUBSTRING_index(infoRaw, ',', -1), ',', 1) where `open` is null
mapper.insert: replace into t_eastmoney_node_buy (`date`, stockCode, `last` , clac_expma_5, clac_expma_10, ratioB, rank_, period_cnt_, rank_limit_) select * from ( select `date` , stockCode , tqnb .`last` , clac_expma_5 , clac_expma_10 , clac_expma_10/clac_expma_5 ratioB , rank() over (partition by tqnb.stockCode order by clac_expma_10/clac_expma_5 desc, `date` desc ) rank_ , count(1) over(partition by stockCode ) period_cnt_ , count(1) over(partition by stockCode ) * 0.015 rank_limit_ from t_eastmoney_node tqnb where `date` > '2020-01-01' and `date` <= #{currDate} and (`date` not like '99999%' or `date` = #{currDate}) -- order by 3, 2 ) tt where rank_ <= rank_limit_ and period_cnt_ > 100 and `date` = #{currDate}
mapper.select: select distinct ten.`date` from t_eastmoney_node ten where ten.`date` > '2020-01-01' order by 1 DESC limit ${days}

with tmp_days as ( select distinct ten.`date` from t_eastmoney_node ten where ten.`date` > '2020-01-01' order by 1 DESC limit ${days} ) select concat('3_', t3.stockCode, '-', t3.stockName, '-', replace(t1.date, '-', '') ,round(t1.ratioB, 3), '-', t1.rank_, '/', t1.rank_limit_, '-', round(t1.clac_expma_5, 3), '-', round(t1.clac_expma_10, 3) ) stockCode, t1.date, t1.last, t1.ratioB from t_eastmoney_node_buy t1, tmp_days t2, t_hs300 t3 where t1.`date` = t2.`date` and t1.stockCode = concat(t3.stockType , '.', t3.stockCode ) order by 2 desc, 1
mapper.insert: replace INTO t_eastmoney_node (`date`,stockCode,infoRaw,`open`,`last`,high,low,volume,amount,exchangeRaw,clac_expma_5,clac_expma_10) with lastest_info as ( select ten.`date` , ten.stockCode , ten.`last`, ten.infoRaw , rank() over (partition by ten.stockCode order by `date` desc) rank_ from t_eastmoney_node ten where ten.`date` > '2025-06-01' ) , one_info as ( select * from lastest_info tt where tt.rank_ = 1 ) select '99999+0.01' date, stockCode stockCode, concat('99999+0.01', ',0,', round(`last`*(1+0.01), 3), ',0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0') infoRaw, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null from one_info union all select '99999-0.00' date, stockCode stockCode, concat('99999-0.00', ',0,', round(`last`*(1-0.00), 3), ',0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0') infoRaw, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null from one_info union all select '99999-0.01' date, stockCode stockCode, concat('99999-0.01', ',0,', round(`last`*(1-0.01), 3), ',0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0') infoRaw, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null from one_info union all select '99999-0.02' date, stockCode stockCode, concat('99999-0.02', ',0,', round(`last`*(1-0.02), 3), ',0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0') infoRaw, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null from one_info union all select '99999-0.03' date, stockCode stockCode, concat('99999-0.03', ',0,', round(`last`*(1-0.03), 3), ',0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0') infoRaw, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null from one_info
mapper.select: with tmp_all as ( select ten.`date` , ten.stockCode , ten.`last` , rank() over (partition by ten.stockCode order by clac_expma_10/clac_expma_5 desc) rank_, clac_expma_10/clac_expma_5 ratioB, clac_expma_5, clac_expma_10 from t_eastmoney_node ten where ten.`date` >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), '%Y-%m-%d') ) , tmp_today as ( select * from tmp_all t1 where t1.rank_ < 10 and `date` > (select max(`date` ) from t_eastmoney_node ten2 where ten2.`date` not like '9999%') ) select distinct concat('3_', t3.stockCode, '-', t3.stockName, '-', replace(t1.date, '-', ''), '-', t1.rank_, '-', round(t1.clac_expma_5, 3), '-', round(t1.clac_expma_10, 3) ) stockCode, t1.date, t1.last, t1.ratioB from tmp_all t1, t_hs300 t3, tmp_today t5 where t1.rank_ <= 10 and t1.stockCode = concat(t3.stockType , '.', t3.stockCode ) and t1.stockCode = t5.stockCode order by 1 desc

with tmp_all as ( select ten.* -- ten.`date` , ten.stockCode , ten.`last`, -- , rank() over (partition by ten.stockCode order by clac_expma_10/clac_expma_5 desc) rank_, clac_expma_10/clac_expma_5 ratioB, clac_expma_5, clac_expma_10 from t_eastmoney_node ten where ten.`date` >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 365+30 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') or ten.`date` like '9999%' ) , tmp_calc_days as ( select distinct t1.date end_date , case when t1.`date` like '9999%' then DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 365 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') else DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(t1.date, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 365 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') end start_date from tmp_all t1 where t1.date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') ) select concat('3_', t3.stockCode, '-', t3.stockName, '-', t1.rank_, '-', round(t1.clac_expma_5, 3), '-', round(t1.clac_expma_10, 3) ) stockCode, t1.date, t1.last, t1.ratioB from ( select t1.end_date, t2.`date` , t2.stockCode , t2.`last` , rank() over (partition by end_date, stockCode order by clac_expma_10/clac_expma_5 desc) rank_ , clac_expma_10/clac_expma_5 ratioB, clac_expma_5, clac_expma_10 from tmp_calc_days t1, t_eastmoney_node t2 where t2.`date` BETWEEN t1.start_date and t1.end_date ) t1, t_hs300 t3 where t1.rank_ <= 3 and t1.end_date = t1.`date` and t1.stockCode = concat(t3.stockType , '.', t3.stockCode ) order by t1.end_date desc
